reason: Insurance generally is squarely Financial Services (Rule X 1(h)(4)), but 6320-6324 health plans (UNH, HUM, MOH) are chiefly Energy and Commerce / Ways and Means territory. Keep 6300-6319 and 6330-6499 direct; move 6320-6329 to related.
Banks and banking, including deposit insurance, is the first item of Rule X 1(h)(1). Commercial and savings banks are one industry here; the 'mixed' flag is only the commercial/savings split.

Military and civil aircraft share these SIC codes, but the 11 current securities are mostly defense-industrial-base suppliers (BA, RTX, HON, TDG, DCO, AVAV). Caveat: a civil-only aircraft supplier would match too; note that all 27 trades come from one politician.

Securities and exchanges (Rule X 1(h)(9)): exchanges, brokers, commodity brokers and investment advisers are all securities-regulation subjects. Overlap with Agriculture 6221 should be one signal, not two.
Capital Markets is squarely securities and exchanges; same range as the verified committee-level row, so it adds attribution, not new reach.

Credit institutions (6100-6198) are 'money and credit' (Rule X 1(h)(7)), but catch-all 6199 mixes card issuers (AXP, SYF) with crypto and advisory firms (COIN, IREN, MSTR, PWP). Keep 6100-6198 direct, 6199 related; this downgrades AXP/SYF unless a ticker-level exception is added later.
Same as the committee-level insurance row: keep core insurance direct, move 6320-6329 health plans to related.
Same split as the committee-level 6100-6199 row: 6100-6198 direct, 6199 related.
Regulation of interstate and foreign communications (Rule X 1(f)(14)) covers telephone, broadcasting and cable. The groups differ but share one jurisdiction.
Verified wording: 'Regulation of interstate and foreign communications' (Rule X 1(f)(14)). Telephone, radio/TV broadcasting and cable are all in it.

Rule X gives Ways and Means only payroll-funded health programs and Energy and Commerce the rest; Medicare Parts A and B practice is not in the wording I read. Verify the Health Subcommittee's published jurisdiction; until then treat as related. If confirmed, direct could be limited to 8050-8082 providers.

Generation, marketing, transmission and ratemaking for 'all power', FERC, and all fossil fuels (Rule X 1(f)(6),(9),(10)) cover electric and gas utilities. Local gas distribution is the weakest member but still within 'energy resources'.
Verified wording (Rule X 1(f)(9),(10)): power generation, transmission, ratemaking and FERC. Electric and gas utilities are both energy.
Financial Institutions is squarely banks and depository institutions; same range as the verified committee-level banks row.
'Mining interests generally' and 'mineral resources of public lands' (Rule X 1(m)(12),(13)). Metal mining, gold/silver and other metal ores are one jurisdiction.
Freight arrangement (CH Robinson, Expeditors, Brink's) is an intermediary service, not the transportation modes or infrastructure Rule X 1(r)(20) enumerates. Keep as related.

Nutrition and Foreign Agriculture is about nutrition programs and food aid; food manufacturers are a stretch for 'direct'. Related is defensible; the committee-level meat/dairy/grain rows already cover the clear cases.
'Health and health facilities' (Rule X 1(f)(3)): hospitals, labs, nursing and home health are health facilities and services. Same range as the verified committee-level row.
Verified wording: 'Health and health facilities' (Rule X 1(f)(3)). The several health-services groups are all within it. Overlaps with Ways and Means and Veterans must count as one signal.

Farm-commodity processors (2070 fats and oils: ADM, BG) fit 'general farm commodities'; 2060 sugar and confectionery (HSY) is largely a consumer-goods maker. Keep 2070-2079 direct, move 2060-2069 to related.
Crop and livestock production is 'agriculture generally' (Rule X 1(a)(2)); the range is wide but contains only production agriculture. Only Corteva currently matches.
'Inspection of livestock, poultry, meat products' and 'dairy industry' (Rule X 1(a)(11),(14)) name these industries directly.
Real estate agents and operators are only indirectly 'housing'; the committee-level 6500-6599 row is already related, so this sub-level direct is inconsistent.
Energy and Mineral Resources is squarely mining; same range as the verified committee-level row.
Water transportation and the merchant marine (Rule X 1(r)(12),(20)); Coast Guard and Maritime Transportation. Cruise lines and shippers are in-scope water carriers.

1611/1622 highway and bridge construction fit Highways and Transit, but current matches (DY, MTZ, PRIM) are 1623 utility, pipeline and communication-line contractors. Keep 1600-1622 direct, move 1623-1629 to related.
Same: roads and bridges (Rule X 1(r)(10),(17),(19)) are direct; 1623 water, sewer, pipeline, power and communication line construction is related.
'Water transportation' (Rule X 1(r)(20)) and 'merchant marine' (1(r)(12)) are named. Cruise lines and shipping are within it.
The VA is itself the health provider; private hospitals and nursing homes matter only through community-care contracts. The committee-level row is related, so this sub-level direct is inconsistent.

Commodity exchanges are named (Rule X 1(a)(9)), but the five current 6221 securities are bitcoin and metals ETFs, not exchanges or brokers. Decide whether commodity-linked ETFs count as 'commodity markets'. Overlaps Financial Services 6200-6299.
SIC 1623 mixes water and sewer construction with pipeline, power and communication-line construction (DY is a telecom contractor), so a match does not mean water resources.

Drinking-water supply utilities (AWK, WTRG) fall under the Safe Drinking Water Act, which is Energy and Commerce; Water Resources and Environment covers water resources development and water pollution control. Possible gap: Energy and Commerce Environment has no 4941 mapping.

The three current matches (ICLR, IQV, MEDP) are contract research organizations serving pharma, not beneficiaries of federal science R&D. The parent SY00 8731 direct row has the same issue and should be reviewed together.
'Astronautical research and development', NASA and 'outer space, including exploration' (Rule X 1(p)(2),(8),(12)) name space vehicles. Overlap with Armed Services is one signal.
REITs and royalty trusts are securities issuers and real-estate finance (Rule X 1(h)(8),(9)). Context only; 41 securities, so noisy but never triggers a flag.

Matches 75 securities (49 prepackaged software) on the strength of the word 'Technology' in the subcommittee name. Verify the Communications and Technology subcommittee's published jurisdiction before keeping.
Real estate operators and agents relate to 'public and private housing' and urban development (Rule X 1(h)(8),(10)). Context only.
Same issue: inferred from 'Artificial Intelligence, and the Internet' in the name, matching 75 software and IT securities. Verify the subcommittee's published jurisdiction.

DoD cyber and IT contractors (LDOS, SAIC, CACI) are context; the range also catches unrelated firms (GoDaddy, IonQ, Jack Henry), which is acceptable at related only.
Holding and investment offices (including blank-check companies) relate to securities issuance; one security matches today. Context only.
'Travel and tourism' (Rule X 1(f)(15)): travel agencies (BKNG, EXPE). Context only.
